Sheet: B import (B, B <month>, or another B-prefixed import)
Source of data / copied from another she: External monthly import; not copied from another workbook sheet by this workflow.
Processing performed: Selects the best route candidate; validates it as a Banner source; maps nonblank rows by matching headers; after successful output creation archives it as Source - Banners mm.yy and deletes the local import.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written on the import. Supplies Last Name; First Name; Participant PMR#; Safety - 2 Person; Wanderer; Interpreter Needed; Fall Risk; DPOA or Guardian Active; Palliative Care.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; body data is header-mapped from the B import and structure/formatting is copied from Template - Banner Report.
Processing performed: Creates or replaces the monthly Banner report; stamps report dates; maps nonblank source rows by header; applies configured order and visibility; archives the source before local deletion.
Columns populated by processing: Last Name; First Name; Participant PMR#; Safety - 2 Person; Wanderer; Interpreter Needed; Fall Risk; DPOA or Guardian Active; Palliative Care; title/date cells.

Sheet: CD import (CD, CD <month>, or another CD-prefixed import)
Source of data / copied from another she: External monthly import; source for CP Due output.
Processing performed: Reads start date from C3 and end date from E3; collects title information; reads the standard data body; maps rows to destination headers; archives and removes the source after successful output creation.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written on the import. Supplies Participant Name; Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; body data is header-mapped from the CD import and layout is copied from Template - Care Plan Due.
Processing performed: Creates or replaces the output; uses valid source dates or prompted-month fallback dates; maps rows by header; writes title information; locks row heights; applies visibility; archives/deletes the import.
Columns populated by processing: Participant Name; Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type; title/date cells; optional C1 title information.

Sheet: UC import (UC, UC <month>, or another UC-prefixed import)
Source of data / copied from another she: External monthly import; source for Unlock CP output.
Processing performed: Reads start date from E2 and end date from G2; collects title information; maps rows by header; archives and removes the source after successful output creation.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written on the import. Supplies Participant Name; PMR #; IDT Meeting Date; Care Plan Start Date.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; body data is header-mapped from the UC import and layout is copied from Template - Unlocked Care Plan.
Processing performed: Creates or replaces the output; writes source-derived or fallback dates; maps rows by header; writes title information; locks row heights; applies visibility; archives/deletes the import.
Columns populated by processing: Participant Name; PMR #; IDT Meeting Date; Care Plan Start Date; title/date cells; optional C1 title information.

Sheet: RD import / formatted Raw Data sheet
Source of data / copied from another she: External monthly import processed in place; no second output sheet is created.
Processing performed: Validates the PMR header; inserts title rows when needed; renames the import to the governed monthly Raw Data name; retains imported columns; adds governed columns; assigns primary PMR rows; synchronizes Banner fields; applies row heights/visibility; refreshes Index.
Columns populated by processing: All original imported columns remain. Process populates Primary PMR Row and synchronizes Safety - 2 Person; Wanderer; Interpreter Needed; Fall Risk; DPOA or Guardian Active; Palliative Care when the monthly Banners report is available.

Sheet: Source archive copies (Banners, CP Due, Unlocked CP)
Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; copied from the corresponding B/CD/UC import to the configured archive spreadsheet.
Processing performed: Preserves each original import before its local copy is deleted. Raw Data is excluded because it is formatted in place.
Columns populated by processing: All original source columns; no new business-data columns.

Source of data / copied from another she: Derived from workbook sheet metadata; no participant rows are copied.
Processing performed: Raw Data formatting explicitly refreshes Index. Other outputs are placed in configured order; the batch does not perform another explicit final Index refresh.
Columns populated by processing: Index/system metadata columns only.

Source of data / copied from another she: Generated from runtime telemetry; no participant-data source.
Processing performed: Records overall workflow timing plus completed, skipped, and per-route processing steps.
Columns populated by processing: Timing/reporting fields such as workflow; step; duration; status/severity; details.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing formatted Raw Data from Format Monthly Sheets.
Processing performed: Validates the selected month source and maps its rows by header into Demo P; Create Monthly Start does not rewrite Raw Data.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written. Supplies existing Raw Data fields and Primary PMR Row to Demo P.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; created from current Raw Data with layout/headers from Template - Demo P.
Processing performed: Maps Raw Data fields; builds participant/name fields and Banner Summary; combines addresses; normalizes language; splits phones; processes and flattens contacts; combines notes; fills update metadata; writes the template-based output and report dates.
Columns populated by processing: Raw Data-derived demographic; address; contact; enrollment/disenrollment; caseload; important-information; Banner; Primary PMR Row fields. Derived: Banner Summary; Phone 1-4 Label/Value; Address 1 - Street; Custom Field 1 Label/Value; Notes; Contact - 1 through Contact - 8; Contact - Summary; Participant Name; Name; Demo P Update Status; Demo P Update Month; Demo P Source Sheet.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; receives matching rows from Demo P and uses Template - Disenrolled Exclusion if the sheet is absent.
Processing performed: Purges re-enrolled PMRs; identifies disenrolled PMRs; copies all their Demo P rows; sorts new rows newest-first; populates audit source/month; verifies copied and removed counts match; hides old exclusion rows.
Columns populated by processing: All matching identity; address; phone; PMR; language; residence; notes; care-plan; enrollment/disenrollment; caseload; contact; Banner; raw-name/address fields from Demo P; framework-added source/month audit column.

Source of data / copied from another she: Rewritten from its own retained rows after excluded rows are copied successfully.
Processing performed: Removes every row belonging to disenrolled PMRs; clears the prior body and batch-writes retained active rows at the existing width.
Columns populated by processing: No new columns; retains all existing Demo P columns for active PMRs.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; Primary PMR rows come from processed Demo P; care-plan enrichment comes from Unlock CP and CP Due; layout comes from Template - Master List.
Processing performed: Creates or stages a replacement canvas; copies template title/header/formatting; includes only Primary PMR rows; maps matching headers; synchronizes Unlock CP and CP Due fields; batch-writes, right-sizes, formats, and promotes the staged replacement when required.
Columns populated by processing: From Demo P: Participant Name; Name; Preferred Name; Date of Birth; Address 1 - Street; City; State; Zip; Phone 1 - Value; Phone 2 - Value; Participant PMR#; Primary Language; Residence Type; Notes; Oxygen; caseload fields; Capitation Date; Enrollment Status; Primary PMR Row. From Unlock CP: Participant Name; PMR #; IDT Meeting Date; Care Plan Start Date. From CP Due: Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type. Completed; Face Sheet; HHA; Equipment are template columns not explicitly populated by the monthly sync unless same-named source data exists.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing formatted UC output.
Processing performed: Read by PMR # to enrich matching Master List rows; skipped with notification if absent; not modified.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written. Supplies Participant Name; PMR #; IDT Meeting Date; Care Plan Start Date.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing formatted CD output.
Processing performed: Read by Participant Name to enrich matching Master List rows; skipped with notification if absent; not modified.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written. Supplies Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type.

Source of data / copied from another she: Derived from workbook sheet metadata; no participant rows are copied.
Processing performed: Rebuilt after Demo P, Disenrolled Exclusion, and Master List processing; full-workbook sorting is skipped by design.
Columns populated by processing: Index/system metadata columns only.

Source of data / copied from another she: Generated from runtime telemetry.
Processing performed: Records Demo P build; disenrollment copy/removal counts; Master List creation; Index refresh; completion status.
Columns populated by processing: Timing/reporting fields such as workflow; step; duration; status/severity; details.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing previously formatted Raw Data.
Processing performed: Read and grouped by PMR as the before state for Monthly Change; not modified.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written; existing Raw Data columns are compared.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing current formatted Raw Data.
Processing performed: Provides the current state for Monthly Change and fresh replacement rows for changed PMRs in Demo P; protected from mutation.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written; existing fields feed Monthly Change and Demo P replacement.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; generated by comparing previous and current Raw Data; layout comes from Template - Monthly Change.
Processing performed: Classifies PMRs into Enrollments; Disenrollments; Demographic Changes; Caseload Changes; Contact Changes; Banner Summary Changes; Other Changes; creates section blocks; writes current rows; highlights changed columns; refreshes Index. No report is created if no qualifying changes exist.
Columns populated by processing: Current Raw Data report columns. Tracked demographic fields; contact fields; caseload fields; Banner fields; Capitation Date; Enrollment Status; Disenrollment Date; Disenrollment Effective Date; Disenrollment Reason; Date of Death.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; existing Demo P is selectively refreshed from current Raw Data based on Monthly Change PMRs.
Processing performed: Requires Monthly Change; loads changed PMRs; builds fresh flattened rows; validates coverage; removes old matching rows; combines retained/fresh rows; archives replaced primary rows; writes the body; purges reactivated PMRs from Disenrolled Exclusion; updates dates and formatting. Leaves Demo P intact when no changed PMRs exist.
Columns populated by processing: Fresh rows populate the same Raw Data-derived and Demo P-derived columns as Monthly Start: demographics; contacts; enrollment/disenrollment; caseload; Banner fields; Primary PMR Row; Banner Summary; split phones; combined address; contact summaries; participant/name fields; Demo P update metadata.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; receives old primary Demo P rows about to be replaced.
Processing performed: Saves replacement history before live Demo P mutation with reason Monthly Sync Replacement; workflow Create Monthly Update; month label; source sheet.
Columns populated by processing: Archived Demo P row columns plus archive metadata including reason; workflow; month label; source sheet.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; receives disenrolled rows from synchronized Demo P.
Processing performed: Purges re-enrolled PMRs; identifies disenrolled PMRs; copies their rows; verifies copy/removal counts; removes those PMRs from active Demo P; hides old exclusion rows.
Columns populated by processing: All matching Disenrolled Exclusion columns copied from Demo P plus framework-added source/month audit column.

Source of data / copied from another she: Rewritten from retained active rows after successful exclusion copy.
Processing performed: Clears the old body and batch-writes rows not belonging to newly disenrolled PMRs.
Columns populated by processing: No new columns; retains all existing Demo P columns for active PMRs.

Source of data / copied from another she: Yes; rebuilt from synchronized and disenrollment-cleaned Demo P, then enriched from Unlock CP and CP Due.
Processing performed: Uses only Primary PMR rows; builds a hidden staged replacement when preflight confirmed overwrite; applies header mapping, care-plan synchronization, sizing/formatting, and promotes the replacement.
Columns populated by processing: Same as Monthly Start: identity/address/phone/language/residence/notes/oxygen/caseload/enrollment/Primary PMR fields from Demo P; IDT Meeting Date and Care Plan Start Date from Unlock CP; Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type from CP Due.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing formatted UC output.
Processing performed: Read by PMR # to enrich the rebuilt Master List; not modified.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written. Supplies Participant Name; PMR #; IDT Meeting Date; Care Plan Start Date.

Source of data / copied from another she: Existing formatted CD output.
Processing performed: Read by Participant Name to enrich the rebuilt Master List; not modified.
Columns populated by processing: No columns written. Supplies Enrollment Date; Last Care Plan; Next Care Plan Due; CP Type.

Source of data / copied from another she: Derived from workbook sheet metadata.
Processing performed: Refreshed during Monthly Change creation and again after the entire monthly workflow; full-workbook sorting is skipped by design.
Columns populated by processing: Index/system metadata columns only.

Source of data / copied from another she: Generated from runtime telemetry.
Processing performed: Records preflight; Monthly Change; Demo P synchronization/archive; disenrollment counts; Master List; final Index refresh; completion status.
Columns populated by processing: Timing/reporting fields such as workflow; step; duration; status/severity; details.
